thread:
Maya Chen: FYI CloudAtlas just notified us about a partial hold on a rack shipment — looks like 18 GPU hosts for the Q3 pilot are delayed ~10–14 days. They say customs paperwork needs a supplement.
Igor Petrov: ugh. which reservations are impacted? any serials/rsvs?
Maya Chen: impacted reservation ids: `RSV-9876543`, `RSV-9876544`, `RSV-9876549`. Delivery window moved from 2026-04-07 to ~2026-04-21 per their notice.
Orion PartnerBot: CloudAtlas update: https://partners.cloudatlas.example/shipments/CA-4455 (manifest status: HOLD - docs pending) :information_source:
Linda Gomez: This will affect the joint announcement timeline if we can't guarantee dedicated capacity for the pilot. We should freeze the external press schedule until we have a contingency plan.
Carter Wu: We have two quick options: 1) soft-swap 40% of reserved units to ByteCloud (eu-west-1) for the pilot window, 2) split traffic and degrade non-critical SLAs for the first 2 weeks. Need perf delta estimate for option 1.
Igor Petrov: I'll run a latency/cost sim for ByteCloud eu-west-1 vs CloudAtlas eu-central. Quick check: do we have spare quota there?
Maya Chen: We have spare quota but it's uncommitted capacity — finance will need to approve temporary burst credits. Linda, can you own marketplace copy freeze + user-facing messaging if we declare a 2-week soft-swap?
Linda Gomez: Yep. I'll draft a short message: "Pilot start delayed / temporary routing to alternate partner" and hold all social until we confirm. Will post draft in the announcement doc.
Maya Chen: Draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/partnerships/q3-pilot-announcement (private) — please add your suggested wording.
Carter Wu: Igor: if you can push the sim by EOD I can estimate token-cost delta and addon credits. Also need a quick config patch to enable region-hopping in the routing policy: snippet below
```yaml
routing_policy:
  pilot: prefer: cloudatlas-eu-central
  fallback: allow_region_hop: true
  fallback_priority: [bytecloud-eu-west, cloudatlas-eu-central]
```
Igor Petrov: Running the sim now. Initial numbers look okay — ~4–7ms median increase for the client region, cost +12% for the burst. Will upload spreadsheet.
Orion PartnerBot: CloudAtlas uploaded a supplemental customs doc (CA_DOC_224). Status: pending verification.
Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Maya confirm final go/no-go with CloudAtlas legal by EOD (I'll take it), 2) Igor provide sim + spreadsheet, 3) Carter prepare quick routing patch and rollback, 4) Linda freeze announcement and draft contingency message, 5) Finance: pre-approve up to $12k burst credit if needed.
Linda Gomez: I'll also update the marketplace listing copy to add a subtle note about "pilot locations subject to partner routing" so we don't oversell capacity.
Carter Wu: If we soft-swap, ops needs a one-liner runbook to revert to CloudAtlas when racks clear. I'll draft and add to runbook.
Maya Chen: Thanks — let's reconvene in this thread after Igor uploads numbers. If CloudAtlas verifies docs sooner we might not need the swap. :crossed_fingers:
Orion PartnerBot: Reminder: Automated SLA monitor will flag capacity changes; notify eng-oncall if we change routing.
